diagnostics.name: Backend verifier

items.text: Reza Taghipour, Tehran representative, said the final victory is near and the US tries to create fear through cognitive warfare. He emphasized that if the US attacks, it will be defeated by the people's resistance. He also stated that Iran does not seek war but will not submit to aggression.

Mehdi Taghiani, a member of parliament, proposed securing 30 to 40 billion dollars in foreign resources. These funds could be used to manage the currency market and control inflation. He stated that this amount is feasible to obtain from economies like China and Russia.

Khorasan newspaper, close to Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf, wrote that by examining the developments of the past week, one can easily understand that a decision for the next war has been made in Washington and Tel Aviv. The newspaper also wrote that Tehran, with its history of interaction with Americans, knows that exchanging messages is very unlikely to have a tangible effect at least until after the next conflict.

Ali Taherkhani, 31 years old, was killed on January 8, 2026, in Takestan. His family showed distress at his grave during his birthday ceremony. Videos of this ceremony have been sent to Iran International.

The CEO of Tehran Water and Wastewater Company stated that high consumers decreased from 65% to 47% and low consumers from 5% to 3%. Additionally, good consumers increased from 29% to 50%. He mentioned the paradox of reduced consumption leading to reduced revenue for water companies.

Hassan Qashqavi stated that the issue of revising the Islamic Republic's nuclear doctrine is gaining strength daily. He also said that control over the Strait of Hormuz has become stronger and it will not be opened until the Islamic Republic's conditions are met. Qashqavi added that over seventy percent of enemy news and analyses during the war are false and part of cognitive warfare.

Tania Abbasi, 21 years old, was killed in Tehran by a direct shot to the back of her head. Her mother placed 9 apples to symbolize 9 months of pregnancy and separation from her in the ninth month after her death. The mother called Tania brave and said she will not be forgotten.

Kazem Gharibabadi stated that if the enemy takes new military action, Iran's response will be different. He referred to the difference in Iran's response during the 40-day and 12-day wars. He also emphasized that the Strait of Hormuz is considered a symbol of an Iranian waterway and will be used as a tool to confront enemies.

Abbas Araghchi stated at the 'Ecocide' conference that military attacks by the US and Israel on oil and nuclear facilities constitute war crimes and have caused serious environmental hazards. He added that the UN Environment Program confirmed in March 2026 that oil facilities in Iran were targeted, causing pollution that can spread to soil and water sources. Araghchi emphasized that international law should not be indifferent to environmental destruction during war.
According to a video received by Iran International, the streets of Gonbad Kavus city experienced flooding and water accumulation on the evening of Saturday, October 10, after rainfall.

Vinicius Junior faces a three-match suspension for his red card against Villarreal, which could be reduced to two matches. If confirmed, he will miss the games against Sevilla and Barcelona. Jose Mourinho avoided the post-match press conference to prevent further sanctions on his team.

Ursula von der Leyen described the Houthi attack on Riyadh airport as the deadliest attack by the group so far. She expressed Europe's solidarity with Saudi Arabia and warned that these attacks destabilize vital global centers. The attacks push the region towards increased violence.

The head of the Kashmar Environmental Protection Office announced the issuance of an alternative sentence to imprisonment for a poacher. The accused was sentenced to pay a fine and carry out environmental measures. The alternative sentence includes providing water and food for wildlife and repairing three watering holes.

Mohammad Eslami, head of the Atomic Energy Organization, stated at a conference that Iran should not be deprived of advanced nuclear technology and criticized attacks on Iran's nuclear facilities that the IAEA does not condemn. He described nuclear technology as life technology that saves human lives and the environment.

A worker at the Zarmehr gold mine in Khorasan Razavi province died after falling into a chemical-contaminated water tank. The incident occurred today, Sunday, October 11. The location of the incident is the Zarmehr gold mine.

The Asian Football Confederation has appointed Moud Bonyadifar as the main referee for the match between Beijing Guoan of China and Jeonbuk Motors of South Korea. The match will be held on Tuesday, 5th of Aban, in Beijing. Farhad Morouji and Bahman Abdollahi will be assistant referees, and Hassan Akrami will be the fourth official.

Houshang Hasan-Yari, a military expert, said that the actions of the Revolutionary Guards have made conditions more difficult for the Islamic Republic. He added that the Trump administration is entering a stage where it will have no choice but to respond heavily. This statement was made regarding recent attacks on commercial ships in the Strait of Hormuz.

Hossein Alizadeh stated that behind-the-scenes negotiations between Iran and the US continue. Masoud Pezeshkian met with Vladimir Putin and conveyed Tehran's proposals to Donald Trump. Tehran is ready to be flexible regarding the storage and amount of enriched uranium and to entrust part of it to Russia.

The Iranian-American community in Richmond, with local and state officials present, unveiled a memorial plaque for four Iranians killed during the protests on January 8 and 9. Four cypress trees were planted in Virginia in memory of these victims. They were killed while helping people.

Israeli Channel 11 reported that Israel is considering an independent attack scenario on Iran following the acceleration of Iran's missile and drone capabilities reconstruction. An Israeli official assessed the likelihood of such an attack before the elections as low. This was discussed in an interview with Babak Es-haqi.

A video shows a protester in Damghan writing on a wall the phrase "Blood cannot be washed away with anything." The person is also chanting "Long live Iran, long live the Shah." This video was received by Iran International.

Masoud Pezeshkian stated in a meeting with Tehran elites that he is devoted to his people and country and will stand for them until death. He emphasized that if everyone works together, no power can bring Iran down. Pezeshkian also said that the enemy aimed to weaken Iran by killing its leaders, but this goal will not be achieved through brotherhood and kindness.

Eliud Kipchoge, two-time Olympic champion, won the Melbourne marathon at age 41 with a new course record. He completed the race in 2 hours, 9 minutes, and 10 seconds, marking his seventeenth professional marathon victory. Kipchoge stated that his body is still in peak condition and he can compete with the new generation of runners.

The mother of Parham Aghamohammadi placed 9 apples to symbolize 9 months of pregnancy and separation on the ninth month after her son's death. She said she will shout his name until the truth is revealed. Parham Aghamohammadi was killed on the evening of January 9, 2026, in Tehran.

The head of the judiciary in Isfahan province announced that the identification of immodest and lax individuals regarding hijab and chastity has begun. He emphasized that hijab is a divine command, law, and public demand, and the judiciary is ready to enforce it. He also stated that there is no excuse for not implementing the hijab and chastity law.

Abbas Araghchi, the Foreign Minister, said at the 'Ecocide' conference that US and Israeli attacks on oil, refinery, energy and nuclear facilities have created serious environmental risks. Referring to UN Environment Programme confirmation in March 2026 about targeting oil facilities in urban areas including Tehran, he said oil fires release hazardous compounds that can transfer from air to soil and water and affect the food chain. Araghchi stressed that international law should not remain indifferent to environmental destruction and human rights violations in war.

Mohammad Javad Akbarin said the Houthis have reached their limit due to losing controlled areas and reduced financial and military support from the Islamic Republic. He added that the Islamic Republic may move towards a preemptive attack to activate regional fronts. These statements indicate a change in the Islamic Republic's strategy.

The Italian defense minister stated that Rome's support for Ukraine is based on law and respect for international rights. He warned that this issue should not become a source of domestic political disputes. He also warned about security threats such as cyberattacks and the use of drones against Italy.

Morteza Nemati, a PhD graduate in geography, was summoned to the General and Revolutionary Prosecutor's Office of Abdanan County. He must appear within five days to defend against charges of propaganda against the Islamic Republic system. The summons was issued on October 10th.
A sudden flood occurred on Sunday, October 11, along the Budhi Gandaki River in Nepal, damaging buildings. Muddy waters have flooded surrounding areas. No casualties have been reported so far.

The Houthis warned airlines and passengers about using Saudi airports and airspace. They stated that areas except Mecca and Medina are at risk of attack. The Houthi spokesperson held Saudi Arabia responsible for the consequences of unsuccessful interception attempts.
Behrouz Kamalvandi, spokesperson for the Atomic Energy Organization, said that the Islamic Republic will achieve its interests either through diplomacy or on the battlefield.

A citizen sent a video to Iran International showing pollution, garbage accumulation, and tree cutting on Al-Nasr Street in Khorramshahr. This street is one of the main and central streets of the city. The environmental situation in this area has been reported as concerning.

Maziar Seyednejad, a labor activist residing in Tehran, was released after about a week of detention in Ward 209 of Evin Prison. He was freed on Saturday, October 9, 2026, under a bail order from the Ministry of Intelligence detention center. This news was reported by the HRANA news agency.

Iman Aghayari, a political analyst, said Iran might not directly start a war but could take actions through proxy forces that effectively mean a renewed conflict. He cited internal power struggles and external pressures as reasons for this possibility. He also stated that political disagreements reflect the regime's desperation, lacking readiness for war or a stable agreement.

Steel pensioners in Isfahan held a protest march from Darvazeh Dolat to the governor's office. They protested against the performance of Dana insurance company and the lack of adequate coverage for medical expenses. They also demanded the full implementation of the salary adjustment plan up to 90 percent.

Mothers seeking justice commemorated nine months since their separation from their children after the January massacre by placing nine apples beside their photos. They spoke of the hopes and dreams that were left unfulfilled due to the loss of their children. The memory of their children remains alive in the hearts of the mothers.

Branko Ivanković believes visa problems and changing the training camp location affected Iran's performance in the 2026 World Cup. He also criticized the special preparation conditions and the commercial view of world football. Ivanković said Iran had a quality team but could not advance to the next stage.
Retired protesters gathered in the cities of Shush, Isfahan, and Rasht on Sunday, 19 Mehr. They chanted slogans against their situation. These protests were reported based on received videos.

The sister of Ali Mohammad Moradi commemorated the ninth month since her brother's death by placing nine apples as a symbol of nine months apart. Ali Mohammad Moradi, 26 years old, was killed on January 9, 2026, in Marvdasht, Fars province. This video was released in his memory.

Mohammad Seraj, a member of parliament's social commission, criticized the positions of Masoud Pezeshkian and Abbas Araghchi during their trip to New York, stating that 90 percent of Iranians demand revenge for the leader's blood. He emphasized that the killers must be punished and that this revenge is law. Seraj also described the Hormuz Strait reopening plan as Araghchi's personal opinion, saying it requires the US to accept Iran's preconditions.

Mahtab Gholizadeh reported that about eight thousand trucks are stopped at the Bazargan border, and drivers at the Rimdan border wait up to 25 days. The long truck delays have reduced fleet capacity and increased import costs. The cost of transporting goods from Turkish ports to Iran has risen from $1,500 to $8,000 in less than two months.

The director general of education in West Azerbaijan announced a shortage of three thousand teachers and ten thousand classrooms in the province. He also stated that the share of skill-based education should reach 50 percent. Achieving this requires a 12 percent improvement in the coming years.

Today, Sunday, 19 Mehr, a group of Social Security retirees held a protest gathering in Shush. The retirees stated that addressing medical and livelihood issues are their main demands. The gathering was held to seek attention to these problems.

Kamil Jamshidi, a 36-year-old protester, was killed on the evening of January 9, 2026, in the city of Andisheh. A video showing the flower shower at the site of his death and his mother's distress has been released. This video was received by Iran International.

Manchester City has been convicted of financial violations between the 2009-2010 and 2017-2018 seasons. The club has appealed the independent commission's ruling, and penalties such as point deductions or relegation are possible. This issue has intensified the competitive atmosphere with Liverpool.

Lionel Messi scored two goals in his first game after retiring from the Argentina national team. Inter Miami defeated DC United with a big score, helped by Messi and Luis Suarez. Messi leads the MLS scoring chart with 23 goals.

The Esteghlal football team used a government protocol RJ aircraft for their trip to Doha. This aircraft is exempt from flight restrictions, and the club managed to secure it through its managerial connections. This move is described as a way to bypass flight restrictions caused by sanctions.

Omid Ghanooni, a detainee in Khansar, died under ambiguous circumstances. Initial forensic reports indicate drug packets were found in his stomach. Unofficial sources reported that he was beaten during arrest and prevented from being transferred to a hospital.

A group of Iranians living in Germany held a ceremony to commemorate Empress Farah Pahlavi on Saturday, October 10. The event took place in Stuttgart on the eve of her birthday. Videos of the ceremony were received by Iran International.

A number of retired cultural, telecommunications, and social security workers held a protest gathering in Tehran. They demanded an increase in salaries and pensions in line with inflation and payment of arrears. Addressing insurance and medical issues is also among their demands.

Mohammad Reza Naqdi, advisor to the commander of the IRGC, stated that any enemy attack will be met with a heavier response. He warned that if attacks are repeated, economic facilities and AI infrastructure of the enemy will be targeted. He also said many enemy bases in the region have been destroyed.

The Judiciary of the Islamic Republic announced the execution of a man named Danial for killing police officer Reza Ehtaramy in Bandar Abbas. The killing occurred four years ago during a clash with fuel smugglers. The execution of Jaber Khosravi for killing a police officer in Damghan was also announced.

The Iranian Crisis Management Organization announced that seven people died and two went missing due to floods and lightning in five provinces. The two missing persons are in Golestan province. In North Savadkuh, Mazandaran, two bridges were completely destroyed and flooding was reported.

Leila Morvati says diplomatic solutions have reached a deadlock and both sides are ready for military action. It is still unclear which side will take the preemptive action. She believes the Islamic Republic's officials are escalating the crisis instead of resolving it.

Shahrzad Shahbazi, the lawyer of the defendants in the Aliakhani Square case, stated that the charge of killing officers has not been attributed to any of the defendants and the court did not address this charge. So far, five defendants have been executed and seven others face execution. These remarks were made in response to an interview accusing the defendants of killing and burning officers.
Reza Shoja Mazraji, a teacher residing in Sarakhs, was sentenced to four years, one month, and seventeen days in prison by the Fourth Branch of the Revolutionary Court in Mashhad.

The president of the University of Tehran announced the expulsion of two students and warnings and reprimands for several others due to flag burning in protests after December 2025. The president of Isfahan University of Technology also stated that disciplinary rulings were issued for about 30 students related to protests in February and March 2026. This information was provided in an interview with Mehdi Tajik.

Mike Waltz, the US ambassador to the United Nations, stated that Donald Trump will end Iran's efforts to acquire nuclear weapons. He spoke about Iran's nuclear program on X and Fox News. Waltz said that a country solely pursuing nuclear power does not enrich uranium to weapons-grade levels nor build its facilities under granite rock.

On the eve of Farah Pahlavi's 88th birthday, an event will be held in Hamburg with members of the Iranian community. The ceremony is organized by the Pahlavi Centennial Foundation in coordination with Farah Pahlavi's office. Simultaneous events will take place in several other European cities.

Saba Alaleh, a social psychoanalyst, identified factors such as poverty, unemployment, and educational deprivation as contributing to child marriage in Iran. She stated that this issue is not solely the result of individual or family decisions. Some families view early marriage as a way to solve economic and social problems.

A kindergarten in Shahr-e Rey was closed by judicial order due to promoting Erfan-e Halgheh. This action was taken based on complaints or reports related to Erfan-e Halgheh activities. Further details are not available.

Amirsalar Davoodi, a lawyer, was arrested on Sunday, 19 Mehr, after attending the Revolutionary Court in Isfahan. This news was reported by the HRANA news agency. No further details about the reason for the arrest have been provided.

Scott Bessent stated that continued economic pressure could force the Islamic Republic to retreat. He outlined three scenarios for Iran's future: popular uprising, internal conflict within the Revolutionary Guard, or negotiation for a nuclear agreement. Bessent also noted that political developments can be sudden and unpredictable.

Mai Sato, the UN special rapporteur on human rights in Iran, expressed concern about the imminent execution of Habibollah Ghanbarzehi Farjad, a Baloch prisoner. She is closely monitoring his case and has compared it to similar drug-related death penalty cases. The Iran Human Rights organization also warned that his execution is scheduled for October 12 in Kerman prison.

Sohrab Bakhtiyari-Zadeh, head coach of Esteghlal, said before the match against Al-Gharafa that his team is fully prepared and aims to win three points. He emphasized that the match is important and difficult for both teams, and Esteghlal respects the opponent while aiming to play quality football and win. Bakhtiyari-Zadeh also mentioned that the previous game against Al-Sadd is over and tomorrow is a new match where they plan to exploit Al-Gharafa's defensive weaknesses.

Kaya Kallas described the Houthi attack on Riyadh International Airport as terrorist and horrific. She is in contact with the Saudi foreign minister, and EU foreign ministers will discuss regional tensions. Kallas emphasized the need for coordination between the Aspides naval operation and the Saudi naval coalition.

Benjamin Netanyahu, the Prime Minister of Israel, called the Houthi attack on Riyadh airport terrorist and condemned it. The attack killed 12 people and injured hundreds. Netanyahu emphasized the need for a firm stance against terrorism.
Today, Sunday, 19 Mehr 1405, a group of retired cultural and social security workers held a protest gathering in Rasht. The protesters demanded attention to their livelihood and medical problems.

An Iranian runner participated in the 10-kilometer run in London on Sunday, October 11. He carried a model of the map of Iran and the Lion and Sun flag. A video of this event was received by Iran International.

The UK Maritime Trade Operations reported that an oil tanker passing through the Strait of Hormuz was hit by an unidentified projectile on its left side. The impact damaged the ship, but all crew members are safe and no environmental consequences have been reported. Fars News Agency also reported a fire on a ship in the southern route of the Strait of Hormuz.

Mohsen Rezaei stated that Americans use five or six small vessels to transfer oil to larger tankers in the Strait of Hormuz. He said Iran targets five or six of these vessels every night. Rezaei also emphasized that the Strait of Hormuz is under the control of the Islamic Republic.

A memorial birthday ceremony for Behbud Hassanzadeh was held with the presence of his family and close ones at his grave. Behbud Hassanzadeh, 36 years old, was killed on the evening of January 8, 2026, in the city of Qaemiyeh. The ceremony was held in his memory.

Alireza Namvar Haghighi stated that comparing the current situation of the Islamic Republic to the fall of the Berlin Wall is not accurate. He considers the collapse of the Soviet Union a closer historical example for Iran. This example involves economic crisis, power structure conflicts, and public protests.

A citizen was arrested for holding a celebration outside Islamic norms at the Parandmal complex. The arrest was ordered by the prosecutor of Robat Karim county. The financial supporter of the event was detained.

Amirsalar Davoodi, a lawyer and human rights activist, was arrested at the Revolutionary Court of Isfahan while defending Mahshad Keshani. A new case was opened for him in Branch 15 and a detention order was issued. The charges against Davoodi have not yet been specified.

Clarence Seedorf has returned to coaching after seven years and taken charge of Brazil's Corinthians, signing a contract until the end of 2027. He replaced Fernando Diniz and will work alongside Memphis Depay. Seedorf has previously coached several teams and is familiar with Brazilian football.

In an attack by the Houthis on King Khalid Airport in Riyadh, 12 people including an American citizen were killed. Simultaneously, the IRGC reported an explosion of a giant oil tanker in the Persian Gulf. These incidents have escalated tensions.
A video shows students tearing and burning images of Khomeini from their textbooks. They also chant the slogan "Long live the Shah." This video was published by Iran International.

Naser Karami stated that the presence of 117 radioactive sources in refineries does not mean radioactive leakage, as many have industrial uses. He added that no documented report of radioactive material release has been published so far. It should not be assumed that radioactive contamination has occurred without evidence.

The sentence of 74 lashes and a fine of 20 million tomans was executed against more than 10 dismissed workers of Petropars Company in Howeyzeh. These workers were arrested and prosecuted due to organizing protests and non-renewal of their work contracts. The sentences were issued on July 4, 2026, by the criminal court of Howeyzeh.

Max Verstappen won the Singapore Grand Prix for the first time, conquering the only current Formula 1 circuit where he had not yet won. Charles Leclerc finished second and Kimi Antonelli third. Verstappen led all 62 laps and finished the race comfortably in first place.

Five Azerbaijani activists named Sima Alipour, Salar Taherafshar, Vahid Abhari Iranq, Nima Radmanesh, and Hossein Esmaeili-Soumeh have each been sentenced to one year in Zabol prison and two years of mandatory residence in the same city. They have also been sentenced to two years of deprivation from electronic services as a supplementary punishment. This sentence was issued by the judiciary.

Hassan Qashqavi stated that the Strait of Hormuz will not be opened until the conditions of the Islamic Republic are met. He added that the Islamic Republic's control over the Strait of Hormuz is becoming stronger day by day. Additionally, more than 70% of enemy news and analyses during the war are false.

In the first 17 days of Mehr, 31 work accidents occurred in 18 provinces. These incidents caused the death of 28 workers and injury to 78 others. Safety deficiencies and lack of protective equipment were cited as main causes of these accidents.

On the early morning of Sunday, 19 Mehr, the execution of a non-political prisoner was carried out in Adelabad Prison in Shiraz. The identity of the prisoner has been confirmed as Esmail Khalili Baseri. This news was reported by the HRANA news agency.
Reza Shasipour, 25 years old, was killed on January 8, 2026, in Izeh. A video showing the grief of his parents at his grave has been released. This news was reported by Iran International.

Reza Pahlavi described the Houthi attack on King Khalid Airport in Riyadh as a sign of the Islamic Republic's unwillingness for peace. He called the attack terrorist and offered condolences to the victims. Pahlavi emphasized that Houthi actions will end when Iran is free and friendly relations are restored.

A video shows the family of Babak Sadeghi Mohseni mourning at his grave on the ninth month after his death. Babak Sadeghi Mohseni was 31 years old and was killed on Friday, January 9, 2026, in Tehranpars, Tehran.

Gol Gohar Sirjan football team will take a difficult route to play against Al-Muharraq Bahrain in the AFC Champions League. The journey includes flights from Sirjan to Tehran, Tehran to Najaf, a bus trip to Baghdad, and then a flight to Muscat, Oman. The match will be held on Wednesday, October 14.
On the evening of Tuesday, October 6, military forces in Zahedan fired at a vehicle. In this incident, a 15-year-old teenager was injured in the head. The shooting was reported as indiscriminate.

Thirty-two maintenance workers of Salman Farsi Petrochemical in Mahshahr have been unemployed for about six months. They are waiting to return to work. They have also demanded payment of their overdue claims.

Parisa Pakbaz, a citizen of Yasuj, was summoned and interrogated for several hours by the intelligence office on Sunday, October 11. Her mobile phone was confiscated by the agents. This news was reported by HRANA news agency.

Manchester City defeated Liverpool 3-0 at Anfield in the sixth week of the Premier League. This was their first match after being sanctioned for financial regulation violations. The club has appealed the ruling and is awaiting the final penalty decision.

The music video "Lili Hoozak" performed by Shadi Amini has been released and received wide acclaim on social media. The project aims to reintroduce Persian poems and games to the new generation, especially Persian-speaking children abroad. The creators have worked to remove inappropriate parts and present the works in a fresh format.

The Yemeni cabinet announced that the country is at a decisive stage to regain sovereignty and end the Houthi coup. The Prime Minister said the Houthis have expanded the conflict by targeting civilians. He emphasized that the Houthis' terrorist actions will not stop the forces' advance.
Twelve people were killed in Houthi attacks in Riyadh. These attacks may lead to Iran's involvement in the war. Niusha Saremi discussed this issue in Titrawal.

A video shows the flower showering at the place where Amirhossein Sheikhloo was killed. This 24-year-old was killed on January 8, 2026, in the Qasemabad area of Mashhad. His family showed distress at the location.

Zhila Sadeghi, a Bahá'í citizen residing in Isfahan, was arrested on Tuesday, October 6, by Ministry of Intelligence agents. She is currently held in solitary confinement in Dolatabad Prison. This news was reported by HRANA news agency.

Kazem Gharibabadi stated that ships passing through the Strait of Hormuz without coordination with the Islamic Republic will face punitive actions by the armed forces. He said Iran is in a state of war and no commercial ship can pass without coordination. A bilateral agreement with Oman on the routes of the Strait of Hormuz has also been reached.

A judicial case has been filed against Adineh Beigi Langaroudi, the wife of Mahmoud Beheshti Langaroudi, a teachers' union activist. The case has been officially opened against her. This news was reported by Harana News Agency.

A video shows the wife of Mohammad Pirusar laying flowers on his grave. Mohammad Pirusar was 37 years old and was killed on January 8, 2026, at Shahnaz Crossroad in Tabriz. The video was received by Iran International.

Khodadad Azizi, head of Tractor, claimed that AFC representatives and the match observer in Oman said the Football Federation must negotiate with the AFC for hosting in Iran. He stated that if this situation repeats, the teams will withdraw from the competitions. The Iranian Football Federation responded that they have corresponded with the football federations of Qatar and Oman for flight permits.

Due to the continued US naval blockade, Iran's revenue from crude oil and gas condensate exports may reach zero by late Azar. Kepler reported that Iran's crude oil loading was zero last month. Exports of other Gulf countries have returned to 81% of pre-war levels.

Kazem Gharibabadi stated that Iran is in a state of war and no commercial ship can pass through the Strait of Hormuz without coordination. The reopening of the Strait depends on the United States fulfilling its commitments. The Strait of Hormuz is part of Iran's national security and defensive capacity.

Nasrollah Fallahi, Gholamhossein Saremi, and another citizen named Shahpour have been detained by security forces for over 10 days. They are held in the Ministry of Intelligence detention center in Ward 209 of Evin Prison. Their detention began in early Mehr month.

The Israeli Prime Minister held a meeting with security officials regarding Iran. The Israeli army is preparing for three different scenarios. Coordination between the Israeli and US armies remains at a good level.

The Sports Facilities Development Company announced the temporary closure of Enghelab and Keshvari clubs due to compliance with religious and legal regulations. The Ministry of Sports stated that their activities will continue with adherence to these regulations. Enghelab club also announced it will be open tomorrow, October 12, as usual.

Mehdi Mahdavi Azad said in the program "Cheshmandaz" that the Islamic Republic is in a situation where both military attack and avoidance of attack could lead to the reproduction of a narrative of victory or the regime's resurgence. He added that the Iranian people are not the ones who determine the start or stop of the war. The main question is what outcome should emerge from this situation in case of attack or continued pressure, and whether this process could lead to the fall of the Islamic Republic.

Najat Bahrami said that the threats by Iranian officials against US data centers and AI are aimed at creating fear and uncertainty in Washington. He added that Iran has resorted to risky gambles after losing opportunities for normalization. Bahrami warned that in case of a new conflict, Iran's nuclear facilities could be a main target.

Meysam Mehrani said that the missile and drone attacks by the Houthis show that Saudi Arabia's military superiority alone has not created effective deterrence. He added that airstrikes are only effective if the Houthis' arms and logistical networks are targeted. Mehrani emphasized that the Houthi crisis goes beyond Saudi Arabia and requires a broader coalition to secure Bab al-Mandab.

The mother of Alireza Naderi lit a candle at his grave as part of the "One Candle, One Name, One Memory" campaign. Alireza Naderi, 27 years old, was injured on January 8, 2026, and died on January 14. The candle was lit in memory of Iran's eternal names and all those innocently executed.

Mohsen Rezaei said Donald Trump, influenced by Netanyahu, started a war against Iran which he called one of the biggest military mistakes in history. He added that the US naval fleet failed to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and Washington has turned to smuggling. These remarks came as the US continues its naval blockade of Iranian ports and Iran's oil exports have decreased.

The UK Maritime Trade Operations reported a drone attack on an oil tanker near Sohar port in Oman. Omani authorities are assisting in evacuating the crew, and damage assessment is not yet available. The IRGC Navy also reported an explosion and fire on a tanker due to hitting a naval mine.

Morad Vaisi, a senior analyst at Iran International, warned that the risk of a larger war in the Middle East has increased due to intensified fighting between the Houthis and the Saudi-led coalition. He highlighted the role of the Islamic Republic, the Revolutionary Guards, and the Houthis in this crisis. This situation could spread the fire of war from Yemen to the entire region.

Saudi Arabia has expanded its energy cooperation with Syria, Qatar, Kuwait, and Egypt. The Central Bank of Syria issued the first banking letter of credit to facilitate oil product transactions with Aramco. The Saudi energy minister signed three memorandums of understanding with Qatar, Kuwait, and Egypt.

Sepahan football team defeated Fajr Sepasi 6-1 in the eighth week of the Premier League. This was one of the highest-scoring matches of the league. With this victory, Sepahan reached 13 points and ranked fourth.

Reza Pahlavi condemned the Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia and held the Islamic Republic responsible. He stated that if the Islamic Republic is overthrown, the region will achieve peace. He also mentioned that Saudi-Iran relations will be restored.

Mohammad Reza Bahonar stated in an interview that the provocation to continue the war is a Mossad conspiracy. He said the enemy uses intermediaries to incite Hezbollah forces towards war. These remarks were published on YouTube three days ago.

Morad Vaisi, a senior analyst at Iran International, said commanders who threatened the US and Israel have been killed. He added that the fate of Mohsen Rezaei and other IRGC commanders could be similar. He also emphasized that the US and Israel still have intelligence and military superiority.

Tractor and Gol Gohar Sirjan football teams traveled to Najaf, Baghdad, and Muscat for their Asian matches. These journeys were difficult. In contrast, Esteghlal used a government VIP plane for their trip to Qatar.

The football teams Tractor and Gol Gohar first traveled to Iraq and then to Muscat for the Elite League and AFC Champions League matches. The Esteghlal team also traveled to Doha with an RJ aircraft belonging to the government protocol of the Islamic Republic. This report was presented by Raha Pourbakhsh in the Hat-trick program.

Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Egypt condemned the attacks by Iran-backed Houthis on Saudi Arabia in a joint statement. They called for an immediate halt to these attacks and held the Houthis responsible for the consequences. The statement was issued following missile attacks on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh.

Amir Giti from Iran International said that the Islamic Republic's threats against US data centers and artificial intelligence could increase US security agencies' sensitivity towards Iranian students and specialists. He also pointed to tensions in the Strait of Hormuz and Houthi attacks, indicating the Islamic Republic's efforts to change regional dynamics. Giti added that the Islamic Republic has not been able to export its oil through the Strait of Hormuz.

Ghassan Ashour said that with the expansion of the Islamic Republic's confrontation from Israel to the United States, the importance of the Houthis for Tehran has increased. The Houthis can disrupt the oil and gas transit route from Bab al-Mandab. The Islamic Republic can use this threat to pressure global energy markets without accepting direct responsibility.

Gina Romero, the UN special rapporteur on freedom of peaceful assembly, announced she will join the 'No to Execution Tuesdays' hunger strike on Tuesday, October 13. She called for a halt to executions and independent monitoring of prisoners at risk of execution. Romero also highlighted political executions in Iran and human rights violations in protesters' cases.

Reuters reported that attacks on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh on Saturday left 13 dead and over 300 injured, leading to the airport's closure. The US Federal Aviation Administration on Sunday asked American airlines to exercise caution when flying to Saudi Arabia or transiting its airspace. The warning is valid until December 10.

Amir Hamidi, a national security expert, stated that the Islamic Republic's ability to disrupt shipping in the Strait of Hormuz with missiles, drones, or naval mines does not mean strategic control of this waterway. He added that Iran cannot impose its political will on the US by threatening to close or restrict passage in Hormuz. Hamidi warned that if threats against international shipping turn into action, the possibility of a defensive reaction and increased US pressure would be serious.

A group of Iranians living in Calgary protested in front of the city hall against executions in Iran and the verdicts in the Ali Khani Square case in Isfahan. They also commemorated the 88th birthday of Empress Farah Pahlavi and expressed support for the people inside Iran and Prince Reza Pahlavi. This report was published by Sepidar Valian from Iran International.

Ahmad Nadari said that the war is ahead and will not end soon. He added that the response to the revenge for the leader's blood has not been sufficient but they are moving in that direction. Nadari also stated that the reaction will be sufficient when full deterrence is achieved.

A ceremony was held in Beverly Hills to mark the 88th birthday of Empress Farah Pahlavi. Hundreds of Iranians attended the event. The ceremony highlighted her role and position in contemporary Iranian history.

Hossein Shariatmadari suggested using the passage of international fiber optic cables as leverage against the US and its allies. He emphasized Iran's right to block internet cables passing through the Persian Gulf and Strait of Hormuz. Shariatmadari criticized officials for neglecting this powerful leverage.
